name: warn-act-notices
title: US WARN Act Layoff Notices — normalized, daily-updated (free tier)
description: Deduplicated, schema-normalized US WARN Act layoff notices from official state labor department listings (29 states), refreshed daily. Free tier: 2024-present, 48h-delayed. Full 1988+ history and zero-delay feed available commercially — see homepage.

sources.title: Official state labor department WARN listings, collected via Apache-2.0 biglocalnews/warn-scraper plus independent normalization/dedup layer

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable dedupe id (source record number where available, else content hash)

fields.name: company
fields.description: Employer name exactly as published by the state

fields.name: company_canonical
fields.description: Cleaned employer name; groups the same employer across states, renotices and store numbers

fields.name: company_dba
fields.description: Trade name when the state published a dba/aka alias

fields.name: employees_affected
fields.description: Workers affected; empty if the state omitted it

fields.name: notice_date
fields.description: ISO date the notice was received/posted (NJ: month precision, day pinned to 01)

fields.name: effective_date
fields.description: ISO date the layoff/closure takes effect

fields.name: first_seen
fields.description: UTC timestamp the pipeline first saw this notice

resources.name: warn_notices_json
resources.description: Same records as warn_notices.csv, as a JSON array

resources.name: coverage
resources.description: Per-state coverage, row counts, source status and freshness metadata

resources.name: trends
resources.description: Per-state monthly notice counts and workers affected, last 24 months
